input.question: Which movie won Best Picture at the 90th Academy Awards Ceremony?

documents.text: Mar 4, 2018 ... ... at the Dolby Theatre during the 90th Academy Awards ceremony on Sunday, with Fox Searchlight's The Shape of Water winning best picture.
